messages.subject: Pylon | Major foundations, infrastructure growth and stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Pylon Leadership Team,

Pylon's specialist role in large foundation and infrastructure projects makes strong institutional and stakeholder coordination an important part of sustainable growth.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination and senior stakeholder strategy.

I bring experience managing high-scrutiny approvals, official engagements, community priorities and cross-functional action across a major industrial operation. My recent work also includes renewable-energy governance and carbon-data readiness, giving me a wider perspective on sustainability and project risk.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional roles in Corporate Affairs, Sustainability, Government Relations, Strategic Partnerships or project stakeholder leadership. I have attached a Pylon-focused executive CV for your review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
